In this masterclass you trace experiments in early stone-built shrines.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • What is early?
  • Gupta/post-Gupta examples
  • Continuity debates

How the time is spent

  1. What is early? 30 min

    Dating by inscription, construction and stylistic comparison.

    You: source evaluation

  2. Gupta/post-Gupta examples 60 min

    Compare Deogarh, Tigawa and Bhitargaon via images.

    You: visual chronology

  3. Continuity debates 30 min

    What can and cannot be inferred about origins.

    You: evidence memo

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.
